title: 3xweek cut gym program
desc: Transform your physique with this 18-week, 3-day-a-week cutting program designed for both novice and intermediate lifters. Each 70-minute workout focuses on building strength and muscle while enhancing athletic performance, utilizing a full gym setup. Experience a balanced blend of resistance training and conditioning that will help you shed fat and define your physique. Get ready to push your limits and achieve the results you've been striving for!
